tvShow.name: Farming Life in Another World
tvShow.overview: After Hiraku dies of a serious illness, God brings him back to life, gives his health and youth back, and sends him to a fantasy world of his choice. In order to enjoy his second shot, God bestows upon him the almighty farming tool! Watch as Hiraku digs, chops, and ploughs in another world in this laidback farming fantasy!

episodes.name: The Almighty Farming Tool
episodes.overview: Hikaru won’t waste his second chance at life; he will focus on what truly matters. And so, he builds a new home with his own two hands.

episodes.name: The First Villager
episodes.overview: As the weeks turn into months, Hiraku’s loneliness grows. He thought he desired a life of solitude, but his wish for companionship grows stronger by the day.

episodes.name: More and More New Roommates
episodes.overview: Hiraku and Lu begin their new life together, unaware of the visitors who will soon arrive at their household.

episodes.name: Waterways Make Life Feel Complete
episodes.overview: Now that they’ve secured a reliable water source, they can start a rice paddy and build a bathhouse.

episodes.name: Curry and Surviving the Winter
episodes.overview: With their homestead completed, they turn their focus to food preparation and just in time; Winter is coming.

episodes.name: This is a Village
episodes.overview: A surprise attack would have shattered their peaceful lives were it not for the almighty farming tool. As word spreads, their home blooms into a village.

episodes.name: A Hospitable Heart
episodes.overview: Hikaru realizes the importance of diplomacy when the demon lord and the dragons establish contact with the Great Tree Village.

episodes.name: The Researcher and The Two Princesses
episodes.overview: They say civilization started because of alcohol. In the Great Tree Village’s case, it instigates a misunderstanding between dragons.

episodes.name: The Merchant and The Dragon
episodes.overview: Hiraku’s offhand comment leads to a series of events that end with a merchant setting up a trade deal with The Great Tree Village.

episodes.name: Princess Yuri
episodes.overview: Spurred by her followers, the demon lord's daughter attempts to invade the Great Tree Village. "Attempts" being the keyword.

episodes.name: Everyday Life, and The Progenitor
episodes.overview: News of the impending birth thrills the villagers, but they aren’t the only ones interested in the good news.

episodes.name: Birth
episodes.overview: Hiraku’s second chance was just the beginning. As he reflects on the changes that occurred since his arrival, one thing is certain: The Great Tree Village is lively as always.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: During the final years of his life, Hiraku Machio remained confined to a hospital bed with a terminal illness until he finally passed away. Taking pity on the unfair life he lived, a god decides to reincarnate Hiraku in another world where he can live as he pleases. Wanting to try farming in this new life, he is bestowed with an all-in-one "Almighty Farming Tool" that can transform into any useful implement he wishes. Hiraku is then transported to a forest seemingly far from civilization. Here, he plans to build and farm everything from scratch—gradually developing the lifeless area into a thriving new society.

episodes.name: Welcome
episodes.overview: New residents mean building new homes. There's just one problem: regular houses do not fit the needs of minotaurs and centaurs.

episodes.name: New Residents
episodes.overview: A change of plans is in order. If the current village can't support the new residents, the solution is simple: build more villages.

episodes.name: Winter
episodes.overview: The Great Tree Village experiences another winter.

episodes.name: Martial Arts Competition
episodes.overview: What better way to mark a celebration than with a martial arts competition?

episodes.name: Another Peaceful Day
episodes.overview: From curing an illness to cultivating new crops to even Mountain Elves curating Hiraku’s favor, life in the Great Tree Village is never dull.

episodes.name: Fine Day for Vistors
episodes.overview: Hiraku has his hands full as mayor. Not only is he tasked with a series of angelic trials, but he must also mediate a draconic relationship.

episodes.name: Hot Spring Expedition
episodes.overview: A hot springs expedition quickly gets out of hand.

episodes.name: More Hot Spring Expedition
episodes.overview: They've dealt with the Lord of Death. Now they need to decide what to do with the black stones.

episodes.name: Return to Ordinary
episodes.overview: A feast celebrates the excavation of the black stones.

episodes.name: Festivities and Fuushu's Gratitude
episodes.overview: The passage of time brings change. A new competition is held, Alfred grows older, and new settlers arrive.

episodes.name: Castle in the Air
episodes.overview: The village must face a flying castle inhabited by demons.

episodes.name: A Village for All
episodes.overview: Hiraku establishes the newly powered Sun Castle as his fourth village. During a grand festival, he unveils a unifying flag while lightheartedly dodging pressure to take on a royal title.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Great Tree Village has grown far beyond the small farm Hiraku once built in the wilderness. As waves of new immigrants arrive seeking refuge, the village faces the challenges of rapid expansion, from housing diverse races such as minotaurs, centaurs, and forest spirits to managing new farmland, resources, and community needs. Between welcoming newcomers, hosting tournaments and festivals, exploring hot springs, and strengthening ties with neighboring powers, Hiraku's dream of a peaceful rural life becomes busier—and livelier—than ever. As the village continues to evolve into a thriving multicultural settlement, every day brings new faces, new projects, and new adventures.

alternativeTitles.title: Chuyển Sinh Thành Nông Dân Tại Dị Giới
